description: Agent directory round 2: check a directory listing draft before you submit it. Input the fields wever_directory-submit accepts: name, website, optional mcp_url, description, category (the directory layer), access (free, freemium or paid) and an optional email, which is checked and never repeated. The signed report evaluates the draft against the standards the Wever directory publishes under: the form field rules, a public HTTPS address for the website and endpoint, a description that says what the service does, the pricing stated, an MCP endpoint whenever the listing claims one, the content screen and the duplicate rule against live listings, with the specific fixes that would make it pass. It submits and publishes nothing. POST /api/directory-listing-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/directory/.

inputSchema.description: The listing draft in the fields wever_directory-submit accepts. Send what you have; missing fields come back as fixes.

access.description: The pricing: free, freemium or paid.

category.description: The directory category (the layer), as the directory names it.

email.description: Optional contact email. It is checked against the form rule and never repeated in the report.

mcp_url.description: The MCP endpoint URL, when the listing has one.

name: wever_directory-listing-check
title: Directory listing check
